rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for long-term weather conditions in a region.

example.english: Hong Kong summers are humid and hot; this climate is really hard to take.
example.traditional: 香港夏天又濕又熱，呢種氣候真係幾難頂。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 haa6 tin1 jau6 sap1 jau6 jit6 ni1 zung2 hei3 hau6 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 ding2

rows.note: Use this for the general political or moral atmosphere surrounding a situation.

example.english: After this debate, the political climate in the council is very tense.
example.traditional: 呢場辯論之後，議會入面嘅氣氛好緊張。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 bin6 leon6 zi1 hau6 ji5 wui6 jap6 min6 ge3 hei3 fan1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this when the climate means prevailing social or moral attitudes and practices rather than a temporary mood.

example.english: Now that the company encourages leaving on time, the workplace climate has improved a lot.
example.traditional: 而家公司鼓勵準時收工，風氣好咗好多。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 gung1 si1 gu2 lai6 zeon2 si4 sau1 gung1 fung1 hei3 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1
